name: shd-migraine-benchmark
description: Benchmark code for next-day migraine and headache forecasting on the Park 2016 smartphone headache-diary (SHD) cohort. It compares gradient-boosted trees, a tabular foundation model (TabPFN) and sequence baselines, and scores each model by pooled AUROC, within-person C-statistic, calibration, Brier skill and decision-curve net benefit.
